audit.whatIsWrong: Rated HARD 7.5/10 with all seven level-chart stages awarded to Urgot, despite a 55.06% Cho'Gath win rate over 178 games and prose that itself says the lane flips at 6.
audit.why: The difficulty label, the diffRating and the whole level chart contradict both the win rate in the packet and the matchup's own whys text.
audit.corrected: EVEN, 5.5/10; chart Skill / Urgot / Urgot / Skill / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath / Cho'Gath with ratings 5,4,4,5,7,7,7.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes were described generically ('his W shotgun legs', 'tank components') with no cooldown anchors.
audit.why: Urgot's power is a cooldown curve: Purge falls 12/9/6/3/0s and Disdain only 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s, so the punish windows are numerically defined.
audit.corrected: Level 2-3 is Urgot's on Purge's 12s rank-1 cooldown; level 6 is Cho'Gath's because Feast is true damage; the Disdain 14-16s window is the all-in trigger.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction was never stated. The page said 'dodge his flip' but never mentioned that Rupture's knockup cancels the Disdain charge, that Feral Scream is a 300-range cone, or that Feast's true damage ignores Disdain's shield.
audit.why: Riot's description of Rupture is 'popping enemy units into the air', and Disdain is Urgot's only dash, so landing Rupture on his charge cancels the engage rather than dodging it. Feast is flagged trueDamage, so his armour, MR and the Disdain shield do not reduce it.
audit.corrected: Rupture on Urgot as Disdain starts cancels the charge with the knockup; Feral Scream then denies the Purge cast; Feast executes through his shield and resistances.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldown section listed 'Urgot Disdain' with no numbers.

audit.whatIsWrong: Fear Beyond Death's 2500 range was never mentioned.
audit.why: It is a cross-screen projectile execute, so staying above the threshold is a positioning rule, not a lane rule.
audit.corrected: Named the 2500 range and the execute threshold in the late-game text.

edits.before: Urgot owns the level 2-3 window: his W shotgun legs and Q AoE pump out steady physical DPS and simply out-trade you before Rupture is reliable. Don't try to trade back into a fresh Urgot — your Q is a slow, telegraphed ground-burst he can sidestep while his legs keep firing, and your Feral Scream silence is wasted if you can't land it on a committed enemy. Last-hit at range, lean on Carnivore to heal the chip, and wait for your combo to come online before you contest.
edits.after: Urgot owns the level 2-3 window: Purge is a 12-second cooldown at rank 1 and his legs proc Echoing Flames on top, so he out-trades you long before Rupture is reliable. Don't trade back into a fresh Urgot - Rupture is a ground-targeted zone he can step out of while his legs keep firing, and Feral Scream is only a 300-range cone, so the silence is wasted unless he has already committed. Last-hit at range, heal the chip off Carnivore, and hold your pattern for his Disdain.

edits.before: By levels 4-5 your Rupture-Feral Scream combo and Vorpal Spikes waveclear stabilize the lane, and at 6 it flips hard. Feast is point-blank true damage that ignores his bruiser-tank stats, so the moment he commits an E-flip onto you, answer with Rupture knockup into Feral Scream — the silence blanks his ability-reliant shotgun rotation while Feast threatens a real execute. Bait the disdain flip, punish it, and don't channel Feast carelessly into his R fear, which can interrupt you.
edits.after: By levels 4-5 your pattern stabilises the lane, and at 6 it flips. The decisive interaction is Rupture's knockup: Disdain is Urgot's only dash, so a Q landed on him as he charges pops him into the air and cancels the engage instead of dodging it, and that is a 14-to-16-second cooldown gone. Follow with Feral Scream inside 300 units so he cannot even start Purge, then Feast - 175-range true damage that his armour and Disdain's shield do nothing about.

edits.before: This is your lane now. Tank components plus Feast stacks turn extended trades in your favor — his shotgun DPS still hurts, but you out-sustain it with Carnivore and out-scale him into a teamfight monster he can't kite, since he's just as immobile as you and your silence shuts his whole kit. The one threat that survives is his R: a low-target execute paired with a fear, so don't dive in at half health and hand him the reset.
edits.after: This is your lane now. Feast stacks plus your health items turn extended trades in your favour - Purge still hurts, but you out-sustain it on Carnivore and out-scale an immobile champion whose single dash your Rupture knockup simply cancels. The one threat that survives is Fear Beyond Death: a 2500-range impale that executes below a health threshold on a 100/85/70 cooldown, so don't skirmish at half health and hand him the reset.

notes: Two kit-file flag misfires. (1) chogath.json tags Rupture (Q) with grounding ('shuts off enemy dashes'), but Riot's description is 'Ruptures the ground at target location, popping enemy units into the air' - the parser fired on the word 'ground'. The same false positive appears on Malphite Q and Olaf Q, neither of which grounds. I wrote the interaction as a knockup cancelling his charge, which the description does support, and asserted no grounding anywhere. (2) urgot.json tags Corrosive Charge (Q) with 'dash', but its description is 'Fires an explosive charge at the target location' - there is no dash on Q; Disdain (E) is his only dash. Whether Feral Scream's silence is cleansable and whether Rupture can be Flash-buffered are not in the data, so I asserted neither.
